propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared 'rebar' logger globally without restoration, breaking caplog capture for rebar.* loggers in subsequent tests
caplog assertions on rebar.* loggers fail silently (StopIteration or vacuous empty record sets) when executed in a test phase after configure_logging() has run in the same process
test failures are intermittent and order-dependent because pytest workers execute tests nondeterministically; a test calling configure_logging() mid-capture creates a void window invisible downstream
propagate=False was set to prevent double-logging through uvicorn/root, but uvicorn does not add root handlers so propagation is safe and the marker-guarded handler ensures single emission
removing the propagate mutation restores caplog capture for rebar.* loggers without reintroducing double-logging
